pitchSettlesAfterUpdates.detail: probe-interface-v1: the first update at full pitch is 2 after the row for every probe pitch and after a rest (update 0 is the start frame), so a note of 3 updates sounds at its pitch

character.summary: Embedded as ELGROOVE for the bass-groove part; envelope A0 D3 S8 R5.

waveforms.detail: probe-interface-v1: waveform bits of the gated, non-TEST updates of the long note MIDI 60, 138 gated updates: noise x1, pulse x136

attack.detail: probe-interface-v1: the long note MIDI 60, 138 gated updates sounds noise for 1 update(s) before it settles on pulse

body.detail: probe-interface-v1: classified from the 137 gated body updates of the long note MIDI 60, 138 gated updates: distinct pulse widths 9, distinct cutoffs 13, noise share 0.007

release.detail: envelope release nibble 5 = 168 ms full-scale (datasheet rate)

level.detail: probe-level-v1: one note at MIDI 45 gated 100 PAL updates, MOS8580, master volume 15, song pipeline render; AC RMS dBFS over the first 250 ms and over 1.0-1.9 s of the note

brightness.detail: probe-level-v1: one note at MIDI 45 gated 100 PAL updates, MOS8580, master volume 15, song pipeline render; spectral centroid divided by the fundamental over 0-60 ms and 50-550 ms (pure triangle about 1.0)

motion.detail: probe-interface-v1: 9 distinct pulse widths in [1792, 2048] over the long note MIDI 60, 138 gated updates, first visible 2 updates after the row
probe-interface-v1: 13 distinct filter cutoffs in [640, 1408] over the long note MIDI 60, 138 gated updates, first visible 2 updates after the row
